levels.text: Lands for 150% Weapon damage, knocks back

name: Ravenous Lunge
notes: In game (hwp_pri_coh_ravenous_lunge, tested): the lunge hits enemies within 50 of the landing for 100/150% of the main hand's damage; rare knocks back. plan-forgemaster-bosses 20261022-084131 (the forced lunge hits the brute beside the body; 25 bodies at a 16% chance). First-pass draft by Claude for the Devil Forgemaster; numbers and names are placeholders. The 3 s channel and the ability lockout stay; this only makes the lunge itself hit.
summary: Your flesh-eating lunge slams into enemies where you land, damaging them before you start to eat.
